dict.string: Montana uses the camera to take photos and videos for your chats.

MT Business uses your contacts to show which of them are already here, checking their numbers against the directory as hashes, to share a contact in a chat, and to save the people you add to your contacts by their @name. Turn this off in Settings, Privacy, Sync contacts.
Montana uses Face ID to show your 24-word recovery phrase.

MT Business uses your location so you can send it in a chat. If a work chat asks for its people's location and you allow it, your location is sent to that chat's managers while you are a member — also in the background, with the location indicator shown, and by itself once in each reporting window. You can stop it at any time on the chat's page.
Montana uses the microphone to record voice messages, videos and calls.
Montana turns an order you dictate into text on this device only; the sound never leaves the phone.
Montana saves photos from your chats to your library.
Montana shows your recent photos and videos so you can send one quickly.
